newsitem.title: USA: World Airways May block hours 4,591.
newsitem.headline: World Airways May block hours 4,591.

text.p: World Airways Inc said Thursday that block hours flown for continuing operations totaled 4,591 for May compared to 5,502 in May 1996, a decrease of about 17 percent.
It said average daily utilization was 10.6 block hours per day versus 12.4 for the same period in 1996.
Block hours denote flying hours under contracts with international carriers, the U.S. Air Force and international tour operators.

For the quarter-to-date ended May 31, block hours totaled 8,889 compared to 9,581 for the 1996 period, a decrease of about 7 percent. Average daily utilization was 10.4 block hours per day versus 11.0 block hours for the 1996 period.
Average aircraft units was 14.0 compared to 14.3 in the 1996 period, the company said.
